title: Dreamers
tagline: A study space that travels with you.
description: Dreamers is a learning platform created by Farhan Balouch for Punjab Board FSc Class XI and XII. It brings textbook PDFs, chapter practice, search and an AI teacher into an offline-focused study space. Download available material before studying without internet; AI features require a connection.

title: Buildora
tagline: Turn an idea into a working website.
description: Buildora is an AI-assisted website-building workspace founded by Farhan Balouch. Describe an idea, work with code and templates, and preview supported projects in one place. Start as a guest with your own AI key; account features include saving projects and exporting source files.

title: Nexus AI
tagline: An intelligent AI chatbot and coding assistant.
description: Nexus AI is an AI chatbot built to be genuinely helpful — an intelligent assistant that can answer questions, think through problems and help with coding.

title: Rawi
tagline: The AI storyteller of Farhan Balouch.
description: Rawi is an AI chatbot and storyteller that knows Farhan Balouch’s journey. It carries the same information that lives on this official website — ask it anything and get the story back.

title: Farhan Deals
tagline: A small idea. A world of possibilities.
description: Farhan Deals is an online shopping project founded by Farhan Balouch in Ahmadpur East, Pakistan. Launched on 1 January 2026, the store brings his interest in e-commerce, product discovery and digital business into one place.

title: SARAS Next
tagline: Your voice. Your computer. A little more connected.
description: SARAS Next is a Windows companion and mobile web controller created by Farhan Balouch. Install the Companion on your Windows PC, pair your phone with laptop approval, and use supported voice and remote-control actions. The computer stays awake, online and running the Companion. Current development preview: 2.0.0-dev.8, released 29 October 2026.

title: Hack AI
tagline: An AI built for cybersecurity, hacking and coding.
description: Hack AI is an AI assistant focused on cybersecurity, ethical hacking and coding — built for people who want to learn how systems work and how to protect them.

title: Movie Hub
tagline: Watch, download and discover movies — with Shorts, a social feed and an AI assistant.
description: Movie Hub is a movie streaming and downloading website. Watch and download movies, scroll Cinephile Shorts (short videos like YouTube Shorts and TikTok), post on an X-style feed, and let the Movie Hub Assistant recommend films for your mood.

title: SARAS City
tagline: A new place in the SARAS universe is taking shape.
description: SARAS City is an upcoming project by Farhan Balouch. Its current preview is available online while the project is being developed; more details will be added as it takes shape.
